name: Job-Application-Tracker--NextJS-FullStack
description: A full-featured job application tracking system built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Clerk authentication, Prisma ORM, React Query, shadcn, Tailwind. It empowers job seekers to efficiently organize & analyze their job search journey via an intuitive dashboard, CRUD operations, analytics, authentication, theming, a highly modular structure.

paragraphs: A production-style, full-stack job application CRM — not a generic job board. It helps you track applications you have already submitted, link them to postings in the app's own Postgres job postings catalog (salary, status, workplace and lifecycle changes), discover new roles to track, visualize your search with charts and KPIs, and (Phase 2) run an AI insights pipeline. Built for learning: App Router SSR, Server Actions, TanStack Query hydration, optimistic UI, multi-layer caching, SSE cross-tab sync, and strict TypeScript end-to-end.
Jobify helps job seekers organize, track, enrich, and analyze their job search in one place. Each authenticated user gets a private dashboard where they can:

The app is built as a learning-oriented full-stack reference: server-rendered pages for fast first paint, client-side TanStack Query for instant interactions, Prisma + PostgreSQL for persistence, and optional Redis/Sentry/Resend for production polish.
features: Add and manage job applications (position, company, location, status, employment mode)
Attach an apply URL so the job links to a catalog posting with salary, status, and workplace data
Search and filter their pipeline with URL-synced filters and pagination
Discover open postings from the built-in catalog and track any role with one click
View stats, KPIs, and multiple chart types (monthly trend, weekly velocity, status/mode breakdown)
